title: Targeting Precision in Cancer Immunotherapy: Naturally-Occurring Antigen-Specific TCR Discovery with Single-Cell Sequencing
summary: Single-cell sequencing plus TCRscape clonotype counts and ERGO-II neural-network binding scores selected a HER2-specific TCR among seven healthy donors; transduced T cells showed differential in-vitro cytotoxicity across antigen-expression cell lines. Experimental proof-of-concept, not a clinical therapy outcome.
